goal: Causal BTC event study on 1m and 5m: when price closes at least 100 points (and the same distance in % of price) under the session VWAP after a flush, measure P(touch within H bars), P(rejection after touch) and forward returns against same-hour base rates and a day-shifted placebo. VWAP per FORMULAS.md section 25; rules per the sources card.
note: REVIEWED:2026-10-26 ACCEPT (Sonnet reviewer Agent reviewers, after 2nd FIX applied once, not re-read, planner DECISION OURS). DECISION (OURS 2026-10-26) defaults: D = 100 pts and 0.12 % of price; flush = a bar in the last 30 with range >= 3x the median range of the prior 60 bars and a close below the close 30 bars earlier; H = 60 bars on 1m, 24 on 5m; touch = high >= VWAP; rejection = touch then a close back below VWAP within 3 bars. Brief ends: Verify: content sha, git cherry origin/fast-track <sha> empty, git ls-tree -r origin/fast-track --name-only lists the delivered files.
scope_out: any entry, stop or strategy claim (event study only)
steps: Gate: VWAP_LEVEL_SOURCES.md and FORMULAS.md section 25 are on fast-track; if not, stop and hand back.

Write test_vwap_flush_study.py first (hand numbers: VWAP, distance flag, flush flag, count totals; planted future read raises; a bar >= 2024-07-01 raises), then ONLY the count-only detector count_events() in vwap_flush_study.py: flags from bars up to t, no forward bar. Session VWAP anchored 00:00 UTC per FORMULAS s25; DEV 2022-01-01..2024-06-30; bt/bt_data.py load_klines 1m, 5m resampled.

Write vwap_flush_PRE_REG.md before any outcome, using the defaults in this card's note (OURS unless the sources card gives a SOURCED value). It prints per variant the event count n and the number of event-days from count_events(). Commit it.

Same PRE_REG, formulas named: MDE = (z_holm + 0.84) * sd / sqrt(n_days) and n for 80 % power = ((z_holm + 0.84) * sd / MDE_target)^2, z_holm = Phi^-1(1 - 0.05/(2m)). Holm m = 20 (4 variants x 5 endpoints: touch, rejection, 5/15/60-bar returns; OURS), or the larger verdicts.py count --split DEV recount.

Units: return endpoints use sd in bp from the unconditioned DEV forward-return series (never event outcomes) and MDE in bp; touch and rejection rates use sd = 0.5 (worst case p0 = 0.5), MDE in percentage points. Do not use prereg_gate.py: it takes sd of per-event R, and a % return has no R.
